executionNotes: The first local recovery parser attempt failed before Gradle because PowerShell parsed $label: as an invalid variable reference; ${label}: fixed the command. No secret value was emitted.

The first APK verification helper mis-decoded the escaped sdk.dir value and therefore did not invoke apksigner/aapt; it was rerun with the already documented absolute SDK path and passed. These were command-construction errors, not product failures.

Two 60-second gh run watch windows expired while the 4m18s workflow was legitimately building; a later poll encountered one transient unexpected EOF. The final watch returned exit 0 and all workflow steps passed.
The first gh release view requested an unsupported isLatest JSON field and exited before reading release data; the corrected gh release/API calls passed.
